announcements.attchmntText: CARYSIL LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Transcript
announcements.voiceSummary: Carysil Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call held on November 05, 2026. The company reported a record second quarter revenue of INR275.7 crores, representing a 14.6% year-on-year growth. Core sink business volumes grew, with quartz sinks up 10% and stainless steel sinks up 8%. Capacity expansion for quartz and steel sinks is targeted for the end of FY2027. International partners include IKEA, Lowe's, and Home Depot. Domestic revenue grew by 30% in the first half. The company appointed Bobby Deol as brand ambassador for FY2027 and FY2028. Management maintains FY2027 guidance of 15% revenue growth and an EBITDA margin of 18% to 20%. Q2 EBITDA margin was 19.4%. Profit after tax increased by 5.8% to reflect higher raw material costs and sea freight.

announcements.attchmntText: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about newspaper Advertisement   Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations )
announcements.voiceSummary: Tata Steel Limited published a newspaper advertisement regarding the audited Standalone and unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisement was published in The Free Press Journal, The Indian Express, Financial Express, Navshakti, and Loksatta. It includes a Quick Response Code and a weblink to access the financial results. This disclosure complies with Regulation 47 read with other applicable provisions of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The information is also available on the company website at www.tatasteel.com. Separately, State Bank of India issued an e-auction sale notice for immovable properties under the SARFAESI Act. The auction is scheduled for December 9, 2026, between 11:00 am and 4:00 pm. Properties include a flat in Vasai East with a reserve price of Rs. 11,00,000 and a flat in Kulgaon with a reserve price of Rs. 26,00,000. HDFC Bank also published a notice under Section 13 of the SARFAESI Act regarding the sale of secured assets. The auction date is November 9, 2026.

announcements.attchmntText: Larsen & Toubro Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
announcements.voiceSummary: Larsen & Toubro Limited has secured a significant order from Noida Metro Rail Corporation Ltd for the design and construction of the Noida Metro Aqua Line Extension Project. The Heavy Civil Infrastructure business vertical will handle part design and construction of a 15.1 km elevated viaduct extending from Botanical Garden to Noida Sector-142, and from Depot Station to Boraki. The scope includes building 10 elevated metro stations with architectural finishes. The project is scheduled for completion within 36 months. The order is classified as significant, indicating a value between 1,000 to 2,500 crore rupees. This announcement was issued on November 9, 2026.

announcements.attchmntText: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 38,222 equity shares of face value ₹10/- each in Creative Port Development Private Limited ( CPDPL ) due to conversion of 25,10,830 Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares of CPDPL, as per terms of issue
announcements.voiceSummary: Tata Steel Limited acquired 38,222 equity shares in Creative Port Development Private Limited on November 7, 2026. This acquisition resulted from the conversion of 25,10,830 Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares. The conversion ratio was one equity share for every 65.69 preference shares. Tata Steel’s equity stake in the subsidiary increased from 51% to 57.5%. The company received a cash payment of ₹6,876.11 for fractional entitlements. Creative Port Development Private Limited remains a subsidiary of Tata Steel. The target entity operates in the transportation and storage sector. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required for this transaction.

announcements.voiceSummary: Tata Steel Limited approved its audited standalone and unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
